newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - July 9.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - July 9.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Wednesday:
* On Tuesday, the Dow rose 103.82 points, or 1.32 percent, to 7,962.31, as investors expressed confidence about the outlook for the U.S. economy and second-quarter earnings.

* Oil prices are set to fall later this year as stocks rise despite higher than expected demand due to strong U.S. gasoline consumption this spring, the International Energy Agency (IEA) said yesterday.
* On Tuesday, the Jakarta Composite Index ended up 2.83 points, or 0.38 percent, at 740.83 points as market sentiment on Monday's economic deregulation package improved, brokers said.
* On Wednesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,432.75/32.25 at 0125 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,431.50/32.50.
* Gajah Tunggal on reports the tyre manufacturer had told the stock exhange that it planned to supply tyres to automotive firm PT Timor Putra Nasional.
* Heavy equipment distributor United Tractors on reports it planned to announce a 300 billion rupiah rights issue.
* Property and banking stocks after the government announced measures to limit loans to the property sector.
* Food manufacturer Indofood and Mayora as sugar producers allowed to import raw sugar, dismantling the monopoly held by state commodities regulator BULOG.
* Plantatation firms Bakrie Sumatra and London Sumatra following Indonesia's revision of the export tax structure for palm oil under its economic deregulation package announced on Monday.
* Citra Marga on reports that one of the firm's shareholders, state-owned PT Krakatau Steel, has sold 28.92 million shares, or a 2.89 percent stake, in the toll road operator.
